GeeTest v4: IconCrush, gobang, icons, nine photos and shapes

GeeTest's fourth version shows a "Click to verify" button. Behind it, IconCrush asks you to swap two tiles to line up three identical items; gobang asks you to move a ball to make five in a row; the icon puzzle asks you to click icons in order and press Confirm; the nine-photo puzzle asks you to select images; the SVG puzzle shows an animated grid of shapes.
